limits: No drag/drop; group sorting uses existing shared preference.
Channel read marks do not mark threads read. Viewing does not implicitly mark read.
Unread frontier lookup capped at ten 100-message pages; no mutation if latest top-level message remains unlocated.
Non-idempotent activity.mark failures show unconfirmed status and reread; they are never replayed.
Archive/mute semantics remain Kernel-owned; muting does not stop agents.
